marking: FEASIBILITY ON PUBLIC DATA. NOT CLINICAL EVIDENCE.
title: Score Discrepancy Reconciliation — 6 FN Studies
root_cause:
The classifier scores in conformal_routing_table.csv (Source A) and v2a1_fn_safety_interception.json (Source B) differ because they use different study-level aggregation methods. Both use the SAME model checkpoint (classifier_v2a1.pt) with NO AdaBN and NO temperature scaling applied to study scores. The aggregation difference is:
  Source A (routing table): MAX probability slice per study
  Source B (interception audit): MEAN of TOP-3 probability slices per study
MAX >= TOP-3 MEAN by definition. All 6 FN studies remain false negatives under BOTH aggregation methods at lambda=0.0298.
temperature_scaling: T=0.7984 (NOT applied to study scores in either source)
adabn: NOT applied in either source (base model used for both)

ood_threshold_independence.tau_ood_derivation_cohort: 49 TN auto-cleared studies from full 486-study CQ500 cache
ood_threshold_independence.independence_caveat: The 49 TN auto-cleared studies and the 6 FN studies are disjoint (no overlap by definition — TN and FN are mutually exclusive labels). HOWEVER: the tau_ood derivation cohort is drawn from the SAME 486-study CQ500 dataset used to evaluate OOD interception. The threshold was not derived from a held-out independent dataset. The interception results are therefore EXPLORATORY and within-sample, not an independent validation. This must be disclosed in all communications.

mc_dropout_reproducibility.recommendation: With N=30 MC-Dropout passes, run-to-run variation of 5-15% is expected. For publication, fix torch.manual_seed() before each run or report mean +/- std across multiple independent runs.

corrected_interception_summary.aggregation_for_ood_eval: TOP-3 MEAN (consistent with step16, step18, step19)
corrected_interception_summary.finding: 2/6 FN studies (CQ500-CT-415, CQ500-CT-43) have RMD scores exceeding the 95th-percentile TN threshold. 4/6 are not flagged by either gate. This finding holds under BOTH MAX and TOP-3 MEAN aggregation methods, because the OOD score is computed on penultimate features (aggregated TOP-3 MEAN), not on the classifier probability directly.
corrected_interception_summary.four_missed_failure_analysis_priority: CQ500-CT-385, CQ500-CT-278, CQ500-CT-426, CQ500-CT-196 represent cases that evaded the classifier, OOD, and epistemic gates. These are the highest-priority cases for the next iteration of SEWA's safety architecture. Recommended next steps: (1) inspect raw DICOM for visual and radiological characteristics; (2) evaluate whether subtype-specific thresholds (Claim 5) would have changed routing; (3) assess whether a pre-registered multi-gate threshold calibration on an independent cohort would change the interception result.
